name: eighteen-cosmos-server
description: Authoritative game server. Hosts RoomSession over WebSocket; decides nothing itself (design note #1210).

scripts._comment_build: INVOKED THROUGH `node`, NOT THROUGH THE .bin SHIM, AND THE REASON IS WINDOWS. `.bin/tsc` is a shell script; cmd.exe reads `../frontend/...` as a command it does not have and answers `'..' is not recognized`. `node <path>/bin/tsc` is the same compiler reached in a way every shell agrees about. Same family of fault as the `FOO=1 npm start` note in src/start.ts: an instruction that works for half its readers.
scripts._comment_test: LIVE-3A/3B/3C/2A/2B/2C/2D/2E, the LIVE-2F/3D certification regressions, ESCROW-3A (identity families + re-authentication, the settlement lifecycle, wallet tickets, operator recovery) and ESCROW-3B (the Juno backend: secp256k1/Cosmos-tx/ABI pins, the end-to-end money game on an offline chain, the adversarial matrix, the room host's escrow seam) and ESCROW-JOIN (the join admission: frozen vectors, wire, `authorizeJoin`, the ticket ledger) and ESCROW-4 (the ADR-036 wallet proof pinned to cosmjs; real-money tables end to end over production identity and the offline chain: W-13, R-J1, W-2, Start and its rollback, the consent/annul relay, relinks) and LIVE-4 L4-1 (the canonical compatibility model: the moved protocol constants, ESCROW-3A's money verdict reproduced by the canonical one, this build's capability key): the per-game actor's regressions and the seeded stress run, against the compiled output -- run `npm run build` first. Explicit file paths rather than a directory or a glob, because `node --test` does not read either the same way on every Node version a playtest machine may have. `--test-concurrency=1` (LIVE-2F/3D): the files run one at a time, as every certified run did on its 2-CPU hosts -- several suites spawn real servers, race processes for one lock or wait on wall-clock limits, and a many-core machine otherwise runs all twenty at once.
scripts._comment_logDoctor: LIVE-3B: the offline operator tool for a room log the server holds as damaged. STOP THE SERVER FIRST. `npm run logDoctor -- data/JUNO-XXX.log.jsonl` inspects; add `--repair` (and `--split-poisoned` for the F-8 shape) to write a verified copy beside it. See claude/live3b-hardened-local-store-2026-09-25.md.
scripts._comment_gamesDoctor: LIVE-3C: the offline operator tool for a data directory's games. `npm run gamesDoctor -- status` works while the server runs; `inspect [--deep]`, `release <game_id> --note "..."` and `gc [--apply]` refuse while a server holds the directory, and release/gc hold its lock themselves. See claude/live3c-restore-reconciliation-lifecycle-2026-09-27.md.
